prompt.zh-TW: 綠茵運動用品今年的本期淨利是 {{money:vars.netIncome}}，年底的股本是 {{money:vars.shareCapital}}，每股面額 {{money:vars.parValue}}。請先用股本除以每股面額算出股數，再算出每股盈餘（EPS），取到小數點後兩位。
prompt.en: Greenfield Sports earned a profit for the period of {{money:vars.netIncome}} this year. Its share capital at year end is {{money:vars.shareCapital}} and the par value is {{money:vars.parValue}} per share. First divide share capital by par value to get the number of shares, then work out earnings per share (EPS) to two decimal places.

explanation.zh-TW: 先算股數：股本 {{money:vars.shareCapital}} ÷ 每股面額 {{money:vars.parValue}}。再算每股盈餘：本期淨利 {{money:vars.netIncome}} ÷ 股數 ＝ {{number:expected.answer.value|digits=2}}。這個數字就是本益比的分母；本題的股數用股本推算，是課程的簡化做法。
explanation.en: First the number of shares: share capital {{money:vars.shareCapital}} ÷ par value {{money:vars.parValue}}. Then earnings per share: profit for the period {{money:vars.netIncome}} ÷ number of shares = {{number:expected.answer.value|digits=2}}. This figure is the denominator of the P/E ratio; estimating the share count from share capital is a simplification used in the course.
